items.passage: Today is Friday. Ben checks the date and writes June 19 in his notebook. In the morning, he reads a story. In the afternoon, he plays basketball with May. In the evening, they help Mom cook. Ben is happy because tomorrow is Saturday, and the weekend will start. He plans to visit Grandpa on Sunday.
